import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    ans = 0
    n = len(input_line)
    
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        current = input_line[i]
        j = i
        while j < n and input_line[j] == current:
            j += 1
        length = j - i
        if length % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
